item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Becomes the Preferred Model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model for Microsoft 365 Copilot, highlighting how AI efficiency is becoming a critical competitive advantage. The post OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Becomes the Preferred Model in Microsoft 365 Copilot appeared first on Cloud Wars .
